description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams, which extends a generic FilterParams class. It encapsulates parameters for filtering employee directory search results, including employee numbers, name or ID, job title ID, and location ID. The class sets a default sort field to 'employee.lastName' and provides getter and setter methods for each filter attribute.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating employee directory search filter parameters, including employee numbers, name or ID, job title ID, and location ID, with a default sort field set to 'employee.lastName'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'employee.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers to filter by.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID filter string.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter string.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.
